title: Prescriptions Store Rule: Pause Buffer on Travel Refills
content:
Where the automated refilling of a Kestrel Prescriptions record is paused — an enrollment held under Auto Refill & Medication Sync — a travel refill on it carries the vacation override pause buffer.

## Rule

The vacation override pause buffer looks at an automated refill enrollment on the prescription that is paused, and at the date its pause ends, counted in calendar days from today as day 0:

| Pause ends | Days added |
|---|---|
| 30 or more days after today | 7 |
| one day up to fewer than 30 days after today | 3 |
| otherwise, including no paused enrollment | nothing |

The buffer days are added to the vacation override days supply that remains after its deductions, which is never below zero; the total is taken down to whole days and held to no more than the class's largest vacation override days supply (90 days for a Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription, 30 days for a Schedule V Controlled Prescription or a Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription).

## Both sides (hypothetical, today is day 0)

- Pause ending on day 30: 7 days added. Pause ending on day 29: 3 days added.
- Pause ending on day 1: 3 days added. Pause ending today: nothing added.
- A worked-down days supply of 0 with a 7-day buffer gives 7 days.
